description: Pre-action gates — block or warn on dangerous tool calls. Survives context compaction.

gates.name: no-force-push
gates.message: Force push blocked. Use regular push or ask first.

gates.name: no-rm-rf-root
gates.message: Destructive rm -rf on root, home, or current dir blocked.

gates.name: no-credentials-in-files
gates.message: Credential/API key detected. Use env vars instead.

gates.name: no-git-reset-hard
gates.message: git reset --hard detected. Make sure this is intentional.

gates.name: no-env-commit
gates.message: .env file staged for commit. Run git reset HEAD .env to unstage.

gates.name: no-bulk-git-add
gates.message: git add -A or git add . may stage .env files. Check before committing.
